_comment: Maps BDO market taxonomy 'mainCategory:subCategory' to the coarse category stored on each tracked item. seed_items.py fetches GetWorldMarketList for each entry below and assigns its 'category' to any tracked item found there. 'category' must match a registered insights handler (e.g. accessory, buff); 'type' is an informational sub-type label. Keyed per (main, sub) because a main category can be mixed (e.g. 55 holds costumes, pets, and buff consumables).
